Russian bombardment | Woman and two children killed, ten injured by jets hit displaced people’s tents in north of Jisr Al-Shughur

Idlib province: SOHR activists have documented the death of a woman and two children and the injury of ten others, including children, in airstrikes carried out by Russian fighter jets which hit makeshift tents of displaced people from Aleppo countryside in Al-Nahr Al-Abyad area in the countryside of the northern city of Jisr Al-Shughur, West of Idlib since the early hours of Saturday morning.

Russian fighter jets also have bombed more than 12 areas in the vicinity of Idlib city and Jabal Al-Zawiyah south of Idlib.

“Al-Fath Al-Mubin” faction has counterattacked Russian airstrikes by firing intensive rocket on the regime’s positions in Jorin area of Hama countryside and the vicinity of Maarat al-Numan in the southern Idlib countryside.

Yesterday, Russia concluded the last day of 2021 with four raids on Putin-Erdogan” area, targeting the outskirts of the western city of Idlib and Kansafra town, and the vicinity of Jadidah village in Idlib countryside.

On December 31, SOHR sources reported that Russian fighter jets have executed airstrikes on Idlib countryside, targeting positions in Kansafra, Al-Bara in Jabal Al-Zawiyah, the surrounding areas of Kafr Daryan in the northern countryside of Idlib, the surrounding areas of Al-Jadidah town in the northern countryside of Idlib in the north of Jisr Al-Shughour city and Al-Namerah area in Sahl Al-Rouj in Idlib countryside.

It is worth noting that the airstrikes which targeted a “poultry farm” nearby Kafr Daryan on the Syria border with Iskenderun left two civilians dead and six others injured.
